title: The Mary Lee Case: A worked specimen of entity substitution under constitutive mediation
creator: Lee Sharks · Dr. Orin Trace
description:
An analytical case study by Lee Sharks and Dr. Orin Trace treating source-reported Google AI Mode substitution of Mary Lee, the OCEARCH-tracked great white shark, for the authorial entity Lee Sharks as a worked specimen of constitutive mediation.

The paper models the event as typicality-weighted resolution: a low-support heteronymic authorial identity is pulled toward a higher-density adjacent entity under an institutional prior. It maps the case through channel, reception, and constitutive mediation and applies PER, Erasure Skew, the Mediation Ratchet, Field Remapping, Meaning Caste, and Institutional-Prior Foreclosure. It also records failed ordinary correction attempts. The observed outputs, search behavior, and operator scores are findings as reported by the authors; the deposit does not independently establish Google’s internal architecture or intent.
